source_ref: STUDY: De Pue S, Gillebert C, Dierckx E, Van den Bussche E (2023) Sci Rep 13:9708, doi:10.1038/s41598-023-36718-9, PMC10272225 (CC BY 4.0), and De Pue S et al. (2021) Sci Rep 11:4636, doi:10.1038/s41598-021-84127-7, PMC7907111 (CC BY 4.0). DATA + WORDING: OSF re7sm 'Data/ReadThisFirst.txt' (Columns 51-56) and 'Data/De Pue et al. raw data.csv' (osf.io/download/8bgnt); OSF vfwus 'Data/ReadThisFirst.txt' (Columns 25-30, 120-126, 192-197) and 'Data/Longitudinal_datafile_DePue et al_OSF.csv' (osf.io/download/3db96); supplementary .docx files of both papers checked (all CC BY 4.0). Processing script data/depue_2023_covid_older_adults.py.
note: CODE DERIVATION: the IRW codes ARE the deposit column names (Cognitive_functioning, Remembering, Concentration, Doing_two_things, Recalling, Forgetfulness; M2_/M3_ prefix stripped at T2/T3) plus a rename M2_CognFunct_pre -> CognFunct_pre and M2_/M3_CognFunct_post -> CognFunct_now -- self-describing codes, no positional step. NO LABELS in the CSVs (bare ';'-delimited headers). MAPPING: paper_explicit -- each deposit's ReadThisFirst.txt gives each column's question and anchors against the exact column name (e.g. 'Column 52 (Remembering): have you experienced problems to remember things during the COVID-19 period (on a 5-point scale: 1 = "a lot more than before", ...'); the vfwus readme names the T2 rating columns 'M2_Cogn_funct_pre/_post' while the CSV headers at those positions (120,121) read M2_CognFunct_pre/_post -- same columns. Verified against the data (verify_depue_2023_subjcog.R, VERIFIED): 2021 Table 2 M (SD) and decrease/no change/increase counts reproduced exactly for all six T1 questions; 2023 Table 3 T1/T2/T3 % 'more problems' per subdomain reproduced within 0.5 points (15/15), and each published subdomain's nearest live item is itself (runner-up >= 4.4 points); 0-10 rating Pre 7.75 (0.99 pub vs 1.00 live) / T2 7.49 (1.20) / T3 7.68 (1.24). LANGUAGE: 'The language of the survey was Dutch' (2021 Methods). The ad hoc questions' Dutch wording is in neither OSF deposit, neither supplement and neither paper, so translated_substitute fallback: the study's own English from the ReadThisFirst.txt files ships in the base fields with language=Dutch and no _translated columns. That English is the authors' description of each question, not necessarily a literal translation of what respondents read. TEXT: item_text transcribed verbatim from the readme (lower-case initial, no question mark, as printed); the readme's parenthetical scale description is not part of item_text but supplies option_text. Reference-period variation within one code: the five subdomain items read 'during the COVID-19 period' at T1 and 'in the past month' at T2/T3 (vfwus readme; its T2 Recalling line has a typo 'din the past month'), and CognFunct_now reads '... in the past month (so DURING the COVID-19 lockdown)?' at T2 and '... in the past month?' at T3; item_text ships the T1 form for the subdomains and the T2 form for CognFunct_now, disclosed in public_note. Readme annotations '(i.e. rating retrospectively ...)' dropped. Anchors: Cognitive_functioning 1-3 and the five-point labels as in the readme and 2021 Methods (the 2021 Table 2 footnote paraphrases them as 'a lot more problems than before' etc.; the readme/Methods form is used). CognFunct 0-10: only 10 = 'very good' is shipped; 0 = 'very bad' has no row because no respondent chose 0 (live resp 1-10, validate_items requires exact resp set) -- stated in public_note; points 1-9 unlabelled, option_text blank. No instructions published -> blank. RIGHTS: the study's own ad hoc questions in a CC BY 4.0 deposit; no instrument rights holder. COUNTS: 48 rows; live rows: five subdomain items 640/371/371 (T1/T2/T3), Cognitive_functioning 640 (T1 only), CognFunct_pre 371 (T2 only), CognFunct_now 371+371 (T2,T3).
public_note: Respondents answered Dutch questions; the item text shown is the study's own English description from its data readme. The five 'problems with ...' items refer to 'the COVID-19 period' at the first wave and to 'the past month' at waves 2 and 3, and CognFunct_now's T3 wording omits '(so DURING the COVID-19 lockdown)'. The 0-10 ratings run from 0 = 'very bad' to 10 = 'very good'; no respondent chose 0, so only the 10 anchor has a row.
